name: Make-before-break changeover contact
summary: A make-before-break changeover contact establishes the next path before releasing the previous path during its documented transfer.
description: A make-before-break changeover contact establishes the next path before releasing the previous path during its documented transfer. The temporary overlap must be understood for the connected circuits.
readingNotes: Identify any circuits that would be interconnected during the overlap.
